CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.agreement_review_deadline_v1(p_agreement_id uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 -- Fourteen elapsed days from authoritative current-version completion.
 -- No Agreement/update/message date is a substitute for missing completion.
 select x.completed_at+interval '336 hours'
 from public.agreements a
 join public.agreement_execution x on x.agreement_id=a.id and x.agreement_version=a.current_version
 where a.id=p_agreement_id and a.status='COMPLETED' and x.state='COMPLETED'
  and x.completed_at is not null and isfinite(x.completed_at)
  and x.completed_at<=statement_timestamp();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.agreement_review_published_v1(p_review_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 -- Review stars are immutable, DELETE is forbidden, and account closure keeps
 -- their rows. A later comment hide/redaction cannot undo bilateral publication.
 -- Account/profile closure, world and block gates remain in the existing readers.
 select coalesce((
  select deadline.at_time is not null and (
    statement_timestamp()>=deadline.at_time or exists(
      select 1 from private.agreement_reviews counterpart
       where counterpart.agreement_id=r.agreement_id
        and counterpart.reviewer_account_id=r.target_account_id
        and counterpart.target_account_id=r.reviewer_account_id))
  from private.agreement_reviews r
  join public.agreements a on a.id=r.agreement_id
  cross join lateral(select private.agreement_review_deadline_v1(a.id) as at_time) deadline
  where r.id=p_review_id
   and r.reviewer_account_id in(a.requester_account_id,a.worker_account_id)
   and r.target_account_id=case when r.reviewer_account_id=a.requester_account_id
     then a.worker_account_id else a.requester_account_id end
 ),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.availability_is_future(kind text, s timestamp with time zone, e timestamp with time zone, at_now timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(isfinite(s) and isfinite(e) and s<e and e>at_now
    and (s>at_now or kind in ('TOMORROW_FLEXIBLE','WEEK_FLEXIBLE')),false);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.availability_timezone_valid(value text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  -- ZONE-PERF (2026-10-07). The zone catalog pg_timezone_names reads every zone file of the server (1,196 zones, about 52 ms in CI and
  -- 70-110 ms on canonical DEV per call, warm or cold) and this helper runs for every worker x task pair of the matcher, for every
  -- relative deadline and for every availability save. The two names below are the product's own zones and are known to be in the
  -- catalog (the candidate refuses to apply otherwise); they need no scan. Every other value is judged by exactly the expression
  -- used before, so what is accepted and what is refused is unchanged.
  select case
    when value is null or length(value)>100 then false
    when value in ('Europe/Belgrade','UTC') then true
    else (value='UTC' or position('/' in value)>0)
      and value not like 'posix/%' and value not like 'right/%'
      and exists(select 1 from pg_catalog.pg_timezone_names z where z.name=value)
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.category_of_event(p_event_type text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_event_type = 'OPPORTUNITY_AVAILABLE' then 'opportunities'
    when p_event_type like 'RESPONSE\_%'
      or p_event_type in ('NEED_REVISED','NEED_CANCELLED','CLARIFICATION_CREATED','CLARIFICATION_ANSWERED') then 'responses'
    when p_event_type like 'AGREEMENT\_%'
      or p_event_type in ('MESSAGE_RECEIVED','PRIVATE_ACCESS_GRANTED','REVIEW_RECEIVED') then 'dogovor'
    when p_event_type in ('EXECUTION_STATE_CHANGED','COMPLETION_REQUIRED') then 'execution'
    when p_event_type = 'RECOVERY_OPENED' then 'recovery'
    else 'account'
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dispatch_cheap_candidate_admitted(nid uuid, pid uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.needs n
    join public.app_profiles p on p.id = pid
    left join public.worker_match_preferences pref on pref.worker_profile_id = p.id
    where n.id = nid
      and p.kind = 'WORKER'
      and p.profile_status = 'ACTIVE'
      and coalesce(pref.proactive_notifications, true) = true
      -- MATCH-V1 (owner 2026-10-07): the ONE shared "Odgovara mi" rule: kind of work + area + time and the existing
      -- hard exceptions (own task, other world, identity, exclusions). Tools, vehicles, experience and the
      -- minimum fee are no longer conditions; licenses were retired by WPP01. The rule takes the ROW columns, never
      -- the bare parameters: a parameter-only call is a one-time filter that would run before the status filter above,
      -- for every draft or suspended profile the candidate loop visits.
      and private.worker_need_match_v1(n.id, p.id)
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.opportunity_deliveries od
        where od.worker_account_id = p.account_id
          and od.need_id = n.id
          and od.need_revision = n.revision)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.enqueue_dispatch(p_need_id uuid, p_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT statement_timestamp())
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  insert into private.dispatch_schedule (need_id, next_run_at)
  values (p_need_id, p_at)
  on conflict (need_id) do update
    set next_run_at = least(private.dispatch_schedule.next_run_at, excluded.next_run_at),
        updated_at = statement_timestamp();
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.haversine_km(lat1 numeric, lng1 numeric, lat2 numeric, lng2 numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case
    when lat1 is null or lng1 is null or lat2 is null or lng2 is null then null
    else round((6371.0 * 2 * asin(least(1, sqrt(
        power(sin(radians((lat2-lat1)::double precision)/2),2) +
        cos(radians(lat1::double precision))*cos(radians(lat2::double precision)) *
        power(sin(radians((lng2-lng1)::double precision)/2),2)
      ))))::numeric, 2)
  end;
$function$

 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE

  select case
    when not p_prefs.quiet_hours_enabled then false
    when p_prefs.quiet_start is null or p_prefs.quiet_end is null then false
    when p_prefs.quiet_start < p_prefs.quiet_end
      then (statement_timestamp() at time zone p_prefs.quiet_timezone)::time
             between p_prefs.quiet_start and p_prefs.quiet_end

  end;

 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_published_at is null or not isfinite(p_published_at) then null
    when p_kind = 'TODAY_FLEXIBLE'
      then (date_trunc('day', p_published_at at time zone tz) + interval '1 day') at time zone tz
    when p_kind = 'TOMORROW_FLEXIBLE'
      then (date_trunc('day', p_published_at at time zone tz) + interval '2 days') at time zone tz

  end
  from (select case when private.availability_timezone_valid(p_timezone)
    then p_timezone else 'Europe/Belgrade' end as tz) resolved

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.requeue_changed_worker_profiles_v1(p_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
-- MATCH-V1 (owner 2026-10-07): a direct profile write (the manual profile editor UPDATEs public.app_profiles) brings
-- the open tasks back to the queue as the RPC saves do (private.requeue_open_needs_for_worker_v5): the same open set,
-- the worker's own world, never the worker's own tasks, at most 200 per worker. Exactly once per change: an ACTIVE
-- worker profile whose updated_at lies in (watermark, cutoff] is handled; the cutoff trails this tick by 30 seconds so
-- a write still committing is never skipped. A task that was already reconsidered after the change is left as it is. In the
-- LADDER mode a task that sits inside a running wave window (whose next wave sees the worker anyway) is left as it is too, so no
-- wave is pulled forward; in mode ALL (the default, see dispatch_next_wave) there is no wave window to wait for, so a changed
-- profile re-queues the task even right after its wave and the worker is reached at the next tick.
-- The watermark is one row of private.marketplace_config (data, not schema): no trigger and no new table.
-- Bounded: at most 100 profiles per tick, in (updated_at, account_id) order, with a keyset cursor (so profiles that share one
-- updated_at, e.g. one bulk UPDATE, are neither skipped nor repeated); the rest follows on the next ticks. The 30 second
-- cutoff assumes a profile write commits within 30 seconds of its updated_at (that is the transaction start time).
-- Cost when nothing changed: one config row and one pass over app_profiles.
declare
  cfg jsonb; after_at timestamptz; after_acc uuid; cutoff timestamptz; w record; v_need uuid; all_mode boolean:=false;
  profiles integer:=0; queued integer:=0; last_at timestamptz; last_acc uuid;
begin
  if p_at is null or not isfinite(p_at) then return jsonb_build_object('status','SKIPPED','reason','INVALID_TIME'); end if;
  select value into cfg from private.marketplace_config where key='match_v1_profile_requeue' for update skip locked;
  if not found then return jsonb_build_object('status','SKIPPED','reason','NOT_CONFIGURED_OR_BUSY'); end if;
  select (value->>'mode')='ALL' into all_mode from private.marketplace_config where key='match_v1_dispatch';
  all_mode:=coalesce(all_mode,false);
  after_at:=(cfg->>'after')::timestamptz;
  after_acc:=coalesce((cfg->>'afterAccount')::uuid,'00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid);
  cutoff:=least(p_at,statement_timestamp())-interval '30 seconds';
  if after_at is null or not isfinite(after_at) then
    return jsonb_build_object('status','SKIPPED','reason','WATERMARK_INVALID');
  end if;
  if cutoff<after_at then return jsonb_build_object('status','IDLE','profiles',0,'queued',0); end if;
  for w in
    select p.account_id, p.updated_at as changed_at from public.app_profiles p
     where p.kind='WORKER' and p.profile_status='ACTIVE'
       and (p.updated_at,p.account_id)>(after_at,after_acc) and p.updated_at<=cutoff
     order by p.updated_at, p.account_id
     limit 100
  loop
    profiles:=profiles+1; last_at:=w.changed_at; last_acc:=w.account_id;
    -- The world check (three nested function calls, about 0.15 ms) runs only for the tasks that survive every cheap condition:
    -- the OFFSET 0 fence keeps it out of the scan, so a profile whose open tasks are all queued already costs one pass over the tasks.
    for v_need in
      select c.id from (
        select n.id, n.published_at, n.requester_account_id
          from public.needs n
          left join private.dispatch_schedule s on s.need_id=n.id
         where n.status in ('PUBLISHED','SELECTION')
           and n.published_at is not null
           and n.remaining_search_closed_at is null
           and n.requester_account_id<>w.account_id
           and (n.response_deadline is null or n.response_deadline>statement_timestamp())
           and (s.need_id is null or (coalesce(s.updated_at,'-infinity'::timestamptz)<w.changed_at
                and (all_mode or not (coalesce(s.last_status,'')='SENT' and coalesce(s.next_run_at,'-infinity'::timestamptz)>p_at))))
         order by n.published_at desc, n.id desc
         offset 0
      ) c
       where private.accounts_same_world(c.requester_account_id,w.account_id)
       order by c.published_at desc, c.id desc
       limit 200
    loop
      perform private.enqueue_dispatch(v_need,statement_timestamp());
      queued:=queued+1;
    end loop;
  end loop;
  -- A full batch moves the cursor to its last profile (the rest follows on the next tick); a short batch was everything up to the cutoff.
  update private.marketplace_config
     set value=case when profiles>=100
       then jsonb_set(jsonb_set(value,'{after}',to_jsonb(last_at)),'{afterAccount}',to_jsonb(last_acc))
       else jsonb_set(jsonb_set(value,'{after}',to_jsonb(cutoff)),'{afterAccount}',to_jsonb('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)) end,
         updated_at=statement_timestamp()
   where key='match_v1_profile_requeue';
  return jsonb_build_object('status','DONE','profiles',profiles,'queued',queued,'more',profiles>=100);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.requeue_open_needs_for_worker_v5(p_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare v_need uuid; v_count integer := 0;
begin
  if p_account_id is null or not exists (
    select 1 from public.app_profiles p
     where p.account_id = p_account_id and p.kind = 'WORKER' and p.profile_status = 'ACTIVE') then
    return 0;
  end if;
  -- Same open set as the marketplace reader, the worker's own world only, never the worker's own tasks.
  -- Queueing is idempotent (enqueue_dispatch keeps the earlier run time), and the tick decides eligibility.
  for v_need in
    select n.id from public.needs n
     where n.status in ('PUBLISHED','SELECTION')
       and n.published_at is not null
       and n.remaining_search_closed_at is null
       and n.requester_account_id <> p_account_id
       and (n.response_deadline is null or n.response_deadline > statement_timestamp())
       and private.accounts_same_world(n.requester_account_id, p_account_id)
     order by n.published_at desc, n.id desc
     limit 200
  loop
    perform private.enqueue_dispatch(v_need, statement_timestamp());
    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_handoff_compatible_v1(need_handoff jsonb, worker_handoff jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- Historical missing data stays unknown; it is never rewritten as shipment
 -- consent. Existing unqualified tasks keep their prior compatibility policy.
 IF need_handoff IS NULL THEN RETURN true; END IF;
 IF NOT private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(need_handoff) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF need_handoff->'required'='false'::jsonb THEN
   RETURN worker_handoff IS NULL OR (private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(worker_handoff)
     AND worker_handoff->'required'='false'::jsonb);
 END IF;
 IF worker_handoff IS NULL OR NOT private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(worker_handoff)
    OR worker_handoff->'required'<>'true'::jsonb THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(need_handoff->'shippingCountries','[]'::jsonb)) n(country)
   JOIN jsonb_array_elements_text(coalesce(worker_handoff->'shippingCountries','[]'::jsonb)) w(country) USING(country))
   OR (need_handoff ? 'localExchange' AND worker_handoff ? 'localExchange'
     AND need_handoff#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}'=worker_handoff#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}'
     AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(need_handoff#>>'{localExchange,city}')=
         private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(worker_handoff#>>'{localExchange,city}'));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(p_value jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_city text;
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(p_value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
    OR octet_length(p_value::text)>2048
    OR jsonb_typeof(p_value->'required') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
    OR p_value-array['required','shippingCountries','localExchange']<>'{}'::jsonb
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_value->'required'='false'::jsonb THEN RETURN p_value='{"required":false}'::jsonb; END IF;
 IF NOT(p_value?'shippingCountries' OR p_value?'localExchange') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF p_value?'shippingCountries' THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(p_value->'shippingCountries') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   IF jsonb_array_length(p_value->'shippingCountries') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 32
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value->'shippingCountries') x(value)
       WHERE jsonb_typeof(x.value) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR x.value#>>'{}' !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
     OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.value) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_value->'shippingCountries') x(value))
         <>jsonb_array_length(p_value->'shippingCountries')
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END IF;
 IF p_value?'localExchange' THEN
   IF jsonb_typeof(p_value->'localExchange') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
     OR NOT((p_value->'localExchange')?&array['countryCode','city'])
     OR (p_value->'localExchange')-array['countryCode','city']<>'{}'::jsonb
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value#>'{localExchange,countryCode}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR p_value#>>'{localExchange,countryCode}' !~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_value#>'{localExchange,city}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   v_city:=p_value#>>'{localExchange,city}';
   IF v_city IS DISTINCT FROM btrim(v_city,
      U&'\0009\000A\000B\000C\000D\0020\00A0\1680\2000\2001\2002\2003\2004\2005\2006\2007\2008\2009\200A\2028\2029\202F\205F\3000\FEFF')
      OR char_length(v_city) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 120
      OR v_city ~ ('['||chr(1)||'-'||chr(31)||chr(127)||'-'||chr(159)||'<>0-9]')
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(p_value text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT btrim(regexp_replace(
   translate(
     replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(lower(btrim(coalesce(p_value,''))),
       'ђ','dj'),'љ','lj'),'њ','nj'),'џ','dz'),'đ','dj'),'ß','ss'),
     'абвгдежзијклмнопрстћуфхцчшčćšž',
     'abvgdezzijklmnoprstcufhccsccsz'
   ),
   '[[:space:]]+', ' ', 'g'
 ))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_requirement_tier_inherited_v1(p_req uuid, p_worker_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_req IS NULL OR p_worker_account_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c
  WHERE c.id=p_req AND c.state<>'RETIRED'
 ) THEN RETURN 'NO_SAFE_MATCH'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
  WHERE w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id
    AND w.category_id=p_req AND w.excluded
 ) THEN RETURN 'NO_SAFE_MATCH'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
  WHERE w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id
    AND w.category_id=p_req AND NOT w.excluded
 ) THEN RETURN 'EXACT'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_relations r
    ON r.source_id=w.category_id AND r.target_id=p_req
  WHERE w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id AND NOT w.excluded
    AND r.relation='EQUIVALENT_VERIFIED' AND r.verification='VERIFIED'
    AND r.evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND left(r.evidence_ref,3) <> 'AI_'
 ) THEN RETURN 'EQUIVALENT'; END IF;

 IF EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_relations r
    ON r.source_id=w.category_id AND r.target_id=p_req
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_related_acceptances a
    ON a.worker_account_id=w.worker_account_id
      AND a.source_category_id=w.category_id AND a.target_category_id=p_req
      AND a.relationship_version=r.version
  WHERE w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id AND NOT w.excluded
    AND w.allow_related_offers AND r.relation='CAPABILITY_CONFIRMED'
    AND r.verification='VERIFIED' AND r.evidence_ref IS NOT NULL AND left(r.evidence_ref,3) <> 'AI_'
 ) THEN RETURN 'RELATED_CONFIRMED'; END IF;

 -- Standard coverage tree walk with strict RELEVANCE CEILING (STOP LINE):
 -- Cannot walk up to Level 0 (Crown) or Level 1 (Macro Sectors).
 IF EXISTS (
  WITH RECURSIVE coverage(ancestor_id,visited,depth) AS (
    SELECT e.parent_category_id,
           ARRAY[e.child_category_id,e.parent_category_id]::uuid[],1
    FROM private.work_taxonomy_standard_coverage e
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories c
      ON c.id=e.child_category_id AND c.parent_id=e.parent_category_id
         AND c.state='ESTABLISHED'
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories p
      ON p.id=e.parent_category_id AND p.state='ESTABLISHED'
    WHERE e.child_category_id=p_req
      AND left(e.evidence_ref,3) <> 'AI_'
      -- RELEVANCE CEILING: Exclude Crown (parent_id IS NULL) and Sectors (parent is Crown)
      AND p.parent_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND p.parent_id <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm
        JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes pm
          ON pm.category_id=p.id AND pm.execution_scope=cm.execution_scope
        WHERE cm.category_id=c.id
      )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.parent_category_id,
           coverage.visited || e.parent_category_id,coverage.depth+1
    FROM coverage
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_standard_coverage e
      ON e.child_category_id=coverage.ancestor_id
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories c
      ON c.id=e.child_category_id AND c.parent_id=e.parent_category_id
        AND c.state='ESTABLISHED'
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories p
      ON p.id=e.parent_category_id AND p.state='ESTABLISHED'
    WHERE coverage.depth<32
      AND left(e.evidence_ref,3) <> 'AI_'
      AND NOT e.parent_category_id=ANY(coverage.visited)
      -- RELEVANCE CEILING: Exclude Crown and Sectors from upward expansion
      AND p.parent_id IS NOT NULL 
      AND p.parent_id <> '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001'::uuid
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm
        JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes pm
          ON pm.category_id=p.id AND pm.execution_scope=cm.execution_scope
        WHERE cm.category_id=c.id
      )
  )
  SELECT 1 FROM coverage path
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities w
    ON w.category_id=path.ancestor_id
    AND w.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id AND NOT w.excluded
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities x
    WHERE x.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id
      AND x.excluded AND x.category_id=ANY(path.visited)
  )
 ) THEN RETURN 'INHERITED_STANDARD'; END IF;

 RETURN 'NO_SAFE_MATCH';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_risk_triage_v1(p_label text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_key text;
BEGIN
 v_key:=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(p_label);
 -- Screening is not semantic classification or proof of safety. Apply the
 -- enabled server rules before ambiguity checks so broad or single-word
 -- labels cannot hide a regulated/prohibited meaning behind CLARIFY.
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_risk_rules
            WHERE enabled AND decision='BLOCKED' AND v_key ~ pattern)
 THEN RETURN 'BLOCKED'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_risk_rules
            WHERE enabled AND decision='REVIEW_REQUIRED' AND v_key ~ pattern)
 THEN RETURN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'; END IF;
 IF p_label IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(p_label)) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 120
    OR p_label ~ '[<>{}\\]' OR p_label ~ '[[:cntrl:]]'
    OR v_key IS NULL OR char_length(v_key)<3 OR v_key !~ '^[[:alnum:]]'
    OR v_key !~ '[[:alpha:]]' THEN
   RETURN 'NEEDS_CLARIFICATION';
 END IF;
 IF v_key ~ '(^|[[:space:]])(ostalo|drugo|razno|sve|svasta)($|[[:space:]])'
    OR v_key IN ('digitalni zanati','digitalne usluge','kucne usluge',
      'zanatske usluge','fizicki poslovi','rucni rad','bilo sta','klima','namestaj','nameštaj')
 THEN RETURN 'NEEDS_CLARIFICATION'; END IF;
 -- Natural noun phrases (3D stampa, casovi engleskog, setnja pasa) must not
 -- depend on the first word being in a small Serbian action-verb allowlist.
 -- Existing model semantic/safety review and owner-signed Save are still
 -- required. A candidate result grants no competence or catalog authority.
 RETURN 'LOW_RISK_CANDIDATE';
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_scope_eligible_v1(p_need_id uuid, p_worker_account_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_category uuid;v_revision integer;v_mode text;v_scope text;
BEGIN
 IF p_need_id IS NULL OR p_worker_account_id IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT n.category_id,n.revision,n.execution_location_mode
  INTO v_category,v_revision,v_mode FROM public.needs n WHERE n.id=p_need_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR v_category IS NULL OR v_revision IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 v_scope:=CASE v_mode WHEN 'REMOTE' THEN 'REMOTE'
   WHEN 'STATIONARY' THEN 'ON_SITE'
   WHEN 'POINT_TO_POINT' THEN 'ON_SITE'
   WHEN 'MULTI_STOP' THEN 'ON_SITE'
   WHEN 'AREA_BASED' THEN 'ON_SITE'
   ELSE NULL END;
 IF v_scope IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Only requester's EXACT signed/current need revision may participate.
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_need_snapshots s
  WHERE s.need_id=p_need_id AND s.need_revision=v_revision
    AND s.category_id=v_category AND s.reviewed_by_requester
    AND s.classification_state='CONFIRMED') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c
    JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm ON cm.category_id=c.id
   WHERE c.id=v_category AND c.state='ESTABLISHED' AND cm.execution_scope=v_scope)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Confirmed worker GLOBAL execution choice is necessary, never sufficient.
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.worker_execution_mode_choices choice
   WHERE choice.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id
     AND v_scope=ANY(choice.modes) AND choice.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Require saved human consent for this precise worker+service+scope.
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap
    ON cap.worker_account_id=m.worker_account_id
   AND cap.category_id=m.category_id AND NOT cap.excluded
  JOIN private.worker_ai_saves saved
    ON saved.account_id=m.worker_account_id
   AND saved.review_id=m.source_review_id
   AND saved.client_request_id=m.source_request_key
  WHERE m.worker_account_id=p_worker_account_id AND m.category_id=v_category
    AND m.execution_scope=v_scope AND m.active)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN true;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.work_kinds_v5(p_values text[])
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare
  closed constant text[] := array['SELIDBE_PREVOZ', 'FIZICKI_POSLOVI', 'MONTAZA_NAMESTAJA', 'SITNE_POPRAVKE', 'MOLERSKI_RADOVI', 'ELEKTRO', 'VODOINSTALATER', 'CISCENJE', 'PRANJE_PEGLANJE', 'BASTA_DVORISTE', 'DOSTAVA'];
  fold_from constant text :=
    chr(269)||chr(263)||chr(353)||chr(273)||chr(382)||chr(268)||chr(262)||chr(352)||
    chr(272)||chr(381)||chr(1040)||chr(1072)||chr(1041)||chr(1073)||chr(1042)||chr(1074)||
    chr(1043)||chr(1075)||chr(1044)||chr(1076)||chr(1026)||chr(1106)||chr(1045)||chr(1077)||
    chr(1046)||chr(1078)||chr(1047)||chr(1079)||chr(1048)||chr(1080)||chr(1032)||chr(1112)||
    chr(1050)||chr(1082)||chr(1051)||chr(1083)||chr(1052)||chr(1084)||chr(1053)||chr(1085)||
    chr(1054)||chr(1086)||chr(1055)||chr(1087)||chr(1056)||chr(1088)||chr(1057)||chr(1089)||
    chr(1058)||chr(1090)||chr(1035)||chr(1115)||chr(1059)||chr(1091)||chr(1060)||chr(1092)||
    chr(1061)||chr(1093)||chr(1062)||chr(1094)||chr(1063)||chr(1095)||chr(1064)||chr(1096);
  fold_to constant text := 'ccsdzccsdzaabbvvggddddeezzzziijjkkllmmnnoopprrssttccuuffhhccccss';
  folded text[];
begin
  -- EX-06 ex06b (S06). The hidden kinds of work (PKG-031b): a closed set of ELEVEN kinds recognised by word stems. The NAMES of the kinds are fixed HERE (a twelfth kind is an owner decision and
  -- needs a new body, never a data row); the STEMS are data: private.marketplace_config rows work_kind:<KIND> (a JSON array of literal lower-case substrings, at least 4 letters) and the
  -- classification version in the row work_kinds_head. Each value is folded first: lower case, Serbian Latin diacritics and the Serbian Cyrillic alphabet to plain Latin letters (the three
  -- Cyrillic digraph letters first), so one Latin stem serves every spelling. A kind is named when a stem occurs inside ONE value (never across two values). Text that names no kind returns
  -- nothing, so an unknown word never matches another unknown word. A registry that is not exactly the head row and the eleven kind rows is refused loudly, never half used; an extra
  -- row work_kind:<anything else> is ignored, so no data row can ever add a kind.
  if p_values is null or cardinality(p_values) = 0 then return '{}'::text[]; end if;
  if not exists(select 1 from private.marketplace_config c
                 where c.key = 'work_kinds_head' and c.value ->> 'schema' = 'WORK_KINDS_HEAD_V1'
                   and c.value -> 'kinds' = to_jsonb(closed) and c.value ->> 'foldVersion' = 'SR_LATIN_CYRILLIC_V1')
     or (select count(*) from private.marketplace_config c
          where starts_with(c.key, 'work_kind:') and substr(c.key, 11) = any(closed)
            and c.value ->> 'schema' = 'WORK_KIND_V1' and c.value ->> 'kind' = substr(c.key, 11)
            and jsonb_typeof(c.value -> 'stems') = 'array') <> cardinality(closed) then
    raise exception 'WORK_KINDS_REGISTRY_INVALID' using errcode = '55000';
  end if;
  select coalesce(array_agg(lower(translate(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(btrim(v), chr(1033), 'lj'), chr(1113), 'lj'), chr(1034), 'nj'), chr(1114), 'nj'), chr(1039), 'dz'), chr(1119), 'dz'), fold_from, fold_to))), '{}'::text[]) into folded
    from unnest(p_values) v where v is not null;
  return coalesce((
    select array_agg(distinct r.kind order by r.kind)
      from (select substr(c.key, 11) as kind, c.value -> 'stems' as stems
              from private.marketplace_config c
             where starts_with(c.key, 'work_kind:') and substr(c.key, 11) = any(closed)) r
     cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements_text(r.stems) s(stem)
     where length(s.stem) >= 4 and exists(select 1 from unnest(folded) t where strpos(t, s.stem) > 0)
  ), '{}'::text[]);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_available_periods(pid uuid, s timestamp with time zone, e timestamp with time zone, tz text)
 RETURNS tstzmultirange
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare result tstzmultirange; blocked tstzmultirange; first_day date; last_day date;
begin
  if s is null or e is null or not isfinite(s) or not isfinite(e) or s>=e
    or not private.availability_timezone_valid(tz) then return '{}'::tstzmultirange; end if;
  first_day:=(s at time zone tz)::date; last_day:=(e at time zone tz)::date;
  -- Bound work for malformed/exceptionally broad search inputs, never allocate
  -- or deny an Agreement. Manual response/selection retains its own authority.
  if last_day-first_day>366 then return '{}'::tstzmultirange; end if;
  with days as (select first_day+i as d from generate_series(0,last_day-first_day) i),
  periods as (
    select w.starts_at as a,w.ends_at as b from public.profile_availability_windows w
      where w.profile_id=pid and w.availability_state='AVAILABLE' and w.starts_at<e and w.ends_at>s
    union all
    select (d+r.start_time) at time zone tz,(d+r.end_time) at time zone tz
      from days cross join public.profile_availability_rules r
      where r.profile_id=pid and r.active and extract(dow from d)::integer=any(r.weekdays)
        and r.starts_on<=d and (r.ends_on is null or r.ends_on>=d)
  ) select coalesce(range_agg(tstzrange(greatest(a,s),least(b,e),'[)')),'{}'::tstzmultirange)
      into result from periods where a<b and a<e and b>s;
  select coalesce(range_agg(tstzrange(greatest(a,s),least(b,e),'[)')),'{}'::tstzmultirange)
    into blocked from (
      select w.starts_at as a,w.ends_at as b from public.profile_availability_windows w
        where w.profile_id=pid and w.availability_state='UNAVAILABLE' and w.starts_at<e and w.ends_at>s
      union all
      select c.starts_at,c.ends_at from private.worker_calendar_events c
        where c.worker_profile_id=pid and c.state='BLOCKING' and c.starts_at<e and c.ends_at>s
    ) b;
  return result-blocked;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_calendar_conflict(p_worker_profile_id uuid, p_starts_at timestamp with time zone, p_ends_at timestamp with time zone, p_exclude_agreement_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_worker_profile_id is null or p_starts_at is null or p_ends_at is null then false
    when p_starts_at >= p_ends_at then false
    else exists (
      select 1
      from private.worker_calendar_events e
      where e.worker_profile_id = p_worker_profile_id
        and e.state = 'BLOCKING'
        and (p_exclude_agreement_id is null or e.agreement_id <> p_exclude_agreement_id)
        and e.starts_at < p_ends_at
        and e.ends_at > p_starts_at
    )
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_notify_room_v1b(uid uuid, p_cap integer)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  -- MATCH-V1B (owner 2026-10-07): may this worker still get a PROACTIVE new-task notification today?
  -- It counts the worker's own OPPORTUNITY_AVAILABLE events of normal urgency created in the last 24 hours: the event the
  -- dispatch wave emits for every notified worker (private.dispatch_next_wave -> private.emit_event). Urgent (HITNO) events and
  -- every other event type (responses, agreements, messages, reviews ...) are NOT counted. A null cap means "no cap".
  -- Index-friendly: one range on an existing recipient index (activity_recipient_idx: recipient_user_id, recipient_role, created_at; the
  -- inbox index activity_inbox_page_idx serves the same range), and the count stops at the cap, so at most p_cap matching rows are read
  -- however long the worker's history is.
  select p_cap is null or (
    select count(*) from (
      select 1
        from public.user_activity_events e
       where e.recipient_user_id = uid
         and e.recipient_role = 'WORKER'
         and e.created_at > statement_timestamp() - interval '24 hours'
         and e.event_type = 'OPPORTUNITY_AVAILABLE'
         and e.urgency = 'NORMAL'
       limit p_cap
    ) counted
  ) < p_cap;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_remote_only_activation_ready_v1(p_account uuid, p_skills text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_skill text;v_norm text;v_category uuid;v_matches bigint;v_profile uuid;
BEGIN
 IF p_account IS NULL OR p_skills IS NULL OR cardinality(p_skills)=0 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT id INTO v_profile FROM public.app_profiles
 WHERE account_id=p_account AND kind='WORKER' AND skills=p_skills;
 IF v_profile IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap
    ON cap.worker_account_id=m.worker_account_id AND cap.category_id=m.category_id
   WHERE m.worker_account_id=p_account AND m.active
    AND cap.excluded IS FALSE AND m.execution_scope IS DISTINCT FROM 'REMOTE')
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 FOREACH v_skill IN ARRAY p_skills LOOP
  IF v_skill IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(v_skill)) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 120 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  v_norm:=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_skill);
  IF v_norm IS NULL OR v_norm='' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  SELECT count(DISTINCT c.id),min(c.id::text)::uuid INTO v_matches,v_category
  FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c
  WHERE c.state='ESTABLISHED' AND
    (c.canonical_key=v_norm OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a
      WHERE a.category_id=c.id AND a.normalized_key=v_norm));

  IF v_matches=0 THEN
   -- No spelling authority exists. Resolve only the same service/mode at the
   -- same ordinal in the immutable reviewed plan and its committed result.
   -- Existing/ambiguous canonical or alias matches cannot take this fallback.
   SELECT count(*),min(c.id::text)::uuid INTO v_matches,v_category
   FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap
   JOIN private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
    ON m.worker_account_id=cap.worker_account_id AND m.category_id=cap.category_id
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories c ON c.id=cap.category_id
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm
    ON cm.category_id=m.category_id AND cm.execution_scope=m.execution_scope
   JOIN private.worker_ai_saves saved
    ON saved.account_id=m.worker_account_id AND saved.review_id=m.source_review_id
    AND saved.client_request_id=m.source_request_key
   JOIN private.worker_ai_reviews review
    ON review.id=saved.review_id AND review.account_id=saved.account_id
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 binding
    ON binding.owner_account_id=saved.account_id AND binding.source_review_id=saved.review_id
    AND binding.request_key=saved.client_request_id AND binding.profile_id=v_profile
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_review_batches_v1 batch
    ON batch.owner_account_id=saved.account_id AND batch.source_review_id=saved.review_id
    AND batch.request_key=saved.client_request_id AND batch.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY'
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array'
     THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) WITH ORDINALITY plan(value,ord)
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.result->'items')='array'
     THEN batch.result->'items' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) WITH ORDINALITY item(value,ord)
   WHERE cap.worker_account_id=p_account
    AND cap.excluded IS FALSE AND cap.origin='WORKER_CONFIRMED'
    AND m.active IS TRUE AND m.execution_scope='REMOTE'
    AND m.confirmed_at=cap.confirmed_at AND m.confirmed_at=binding.bound_at
    AND binding.result->>'status'='BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES'
    AND binding.result->>'workerProfileId'=v_profile::text
    AND binding.bound_at>=saved.created_at
    AND saved.receipt->>'accountId'=p_account::text
    AND saved.receipt->>'reviewId'=review.id::text
    AND saved.receipt->>'profileId'=v_profile::text
    AND saved.receipt->>'profileStatus'='ACTIVE'
    AND saved.receipt->'saved'='true'::jsonb AND saved.receipt->'authoritative'='true'::jsonb
    AND review.envelope->>'accountId'=p_account::text
    AND review.envelope->>'reviewId'=review.id::text
    AND review.envelope->>'profileId'=v_profile::text
    AND review.envelope->>'classificationState'='READY'
    AND review.envelope->'canAccept'='true'::jsonb
    AND review.created_at<=saved.created_at AND saved.created_at<=review.expires_at
    AND review.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'=encode(extensions.digest(
      ((review.envelope-'displayedContentDigest')||jsonb_build_object('baseHash',review.base_hash))::text,
      'sha256'),'hex')
    AND batch.review_digest=review.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'
    AND batch.plans=review.envelope->'classificationCandidates'
    AND batch.plans_digest=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(batch.plans::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
    AND batch.result->>'status'='COMMITTED' AND batch.result->'requiresBinding'='true'::jsonb
    AND batch.result->>'capabilityAuthority'='NONE'
    AND batch.result->>'notificationAuthority'='NONE'
    AND batch.catalog_version=binding.catalog_version
    AND jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array'
      THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) BETWEEN 1 AND 24
    AND binding.result->'serviceModeCount'=to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array' THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END))
    AND jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.result->'items')='array'
      THEN batch.result->'items' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)=jsonb_array_length(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array' THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)
    AND jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')='array'
      THEN review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)=jsonb_array_length(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array' THEN batch.plans ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(review.envelope#>'{profile,skills}')='array'
      THEN review.envelope#>'{profile,skills}' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) skill(value)
      WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill.value)=v_norm)=1
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')='array'
      THEN review.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) selected(value)
      WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(selected.value->>'service')=v_norm
        AND selected.value->>'mode'='REMOTE')=1
    AND plan.ord=item.ord AND plan.value->>'action' IN ('REUSE_EXISTING','EXTEND_MODE')
    AND plan.value->>'mode'='REMOTE' AND item.value->>'mode'='REMOTE'
    AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(plan.value->>'service')=v_norm
    AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(item.value->>'service')=v_norm
    AND plan.value->>'categoryId'=c.id::text AND item.value->>'categoryId'=c.id::text
    AND (plan.value->'handoff') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.handoff
    AND (NOT(plan.value?'handoff') OR private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(plan.value->'handoff') IS TRUE)
    AND jsonb_typeof(plan.value->'categoryLabel')='string'
    AND plan.value?'categoryParentId'
    AND c.state='ESTABLISHED' AND c.label IS NOT DISTINCT FROM plan.value->>'categoryLabel'
    AND coalesce(to_jsonb(c.parent_id),'null'::jsonb) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM plan.value->'categoryParentId'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories child
      WHERE child.parent_id=c.id AND child.state='ESTABLISHED')
    AND private.taxonomy_category_path_valid_v1(c.id);
  END IF;

  IF v_matches<>1 OR v_category IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
   SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap
   JOIN private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m
    ON m.worker_account_id=cap.worker_account_id AND m.category_id=cap.category_id
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm
    ON cm.category_id=m.category_id AND cm.execution_scope=m.execution_scope
   JOIN private.worker_ai_saves saved
    ON saved.account_id=m.worker_account_id AND saved.review_id=m.source_review_id
    AND saved.client_request_id=m.source_request_key
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 binding
    ON binding.owner_account_id=saved.account_id AND binding.source_review_id=saved.review_id
    AND binding.request_key=saved.client_request_id AND binding.profile_id=v_profile
   WHERE cap.worker_account_id=p_account AND cap.category_id=v_category
    AND cap.excluded IS FALSE AND cap.origin='WORKER_CONFIRMED'
    AND m.active IS TRUE AND m.execution_scope='REMOTE'
    AND m.confirmed_at=cap.confirmed_at AND m.confirmed_at=binding.bound_at
    AND binding.result->>'status'='BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES'
    AND saved.receipt->>'profileId'=v_profile::text
    AND saved.receipt->>'profileStatus'='ACTIVE'
    AND saved.receipt->'saved'='true'::jsonb AND saved.receipt->'authoritative'='true'::jsonb
  ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 RETURN true;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_remote_review_ready_v1(p_review jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_exact jsonb;v_plans jsonb;v_plan jsonb;v_service text;v_seen text[]:=ARRAY[]::text[];v_n integer;v_category uuid;v_projection jsonb;v_one jsonb;v_saved_services jsonb;v_profile_id uuid;v_owned uuid;v_source text;v_hints jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p_review->>'classificationState' IS DISTINCT FROM 'READY'
 OR jsonb_typeof(p_review#>'{profile,skills}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(p_review->'reviewedServiceModes') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 OR jsonb_typeof(p_review->'classificationCandidates') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF jsonb_array_length(p_review->'reviewedServiceModes') NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 12
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_review->'reviewedServiceModes') m
   WHERE m->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REMOTE')
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_review->'classificationCandidates') p
   WHERE p?'handoff' AND private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(p->'handoff') IS NOT TRUE)
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;

 -- New catalog work is activation consent only, never an existing capability.
 -- Reuse the exact prepare validator (including source-bound hints and handoff)
 -- instead of introducing a second action/path parser. The Save activation
 -- owner separately checks account/session/revision/digest/expiry atomically.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_review->'classificationCandidates') p
   WHERE p->>'action' IN ('CREATE_CHILD','CREATE_NEW_BRANCH','EXTEND_MODE')) THEN
   IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR p_review->>'accountId' IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid()::text
     OR jsonb_typeof(p_review->'conversationId') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR p_review->>'conversationId' !~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   v_projection:=private.taxonomy_review_candidate_projection_v2('WORKER_CAPABILITY',
     p_review#>'{profile,skills}',p_review->'reviewedServiceModes',auth.uid(),
     (p_review->>'conversationId')::uuid);
   -- Activation follows this transaction's own profile writes, so the old
   -- pre-Save source-hash context cannot be re-read here. Preserve only a
   -- separately proven active Save/batch/binding, never supplied JSON alone.
   v_exact:=private.taxonomy_review_exact_projection_v1('WORKER_CAPABILITY',
     p_review#>'{profile,skills}',p_review->'reviewedServiceModes');
   IF v_exact->>'status' NOT IN ('READY','PENDING_CLASSIFICATION')
      OR p_review->'classificationCatalogVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM
        (SELECT to_jsonb(catalog_version) FROM private.work_taxonomy_control WHERE singleton)
      OR p_review->>'classificationCatalogFingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM private.taxonomy_admission_fingerprint_v1()
      OR jsonb_array_length(p_review->'classificationCandidates')<>jsonb_array_length(p_review->'reviewedServiceModes')
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   IF v_projection->>'status'='READY'
     AND p_review->'classificationCandidates'=v_projection->'classificationCandidates'
     AND p_review->'reviewedServiceModes'=v_projection->'reviewedServiceModes'
   THEN RETURN true; END IF;
   v_owned:=auth.uid();
   SELECT p.id INTO v_profile_id FROM public.app_profiles p
     WHERE p.account_id=v_owned AND p.kind='WORKER' AND p.id::text=p_review->>'profileId';
   IF v_profile_id IS NULL THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   SELECT encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(s.candidate::text||'|'||s.revision::text||'|'||s.base_hash,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
     INTO v_source FROM private.worker_ai_sessions s WHERE s.account_id=v_owned
       AND s.conversation_id=(p_review->>'conversationId')::uuid;
   SELECT h.proposals INTO v_hints FROM private.work_taxonomy_turn_hints_resolved_v1 h
     WHERE h.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY' AND h.account_id=v_owned
       AND h.conversation_id=(p_review->>'conversationId')::uuid AND h.source_fingerprint=v_source
       AND h.catalog_version=(SELECT catalog_version FROM private.work_taxonomy_control WHERE singleton)
     ORDER BY h.created_at DESC,h.id DESC LIMIT 1;
 WITH names AS (
  SELECT skill AS service,private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill) AS service_key
  FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_review#>'{profile,skills}') n(skill)
  WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.app_profiles p WHERE p.id=v_profile_id
    AND p.account_id=v_owned AND p.kind='WORKER' AND p.profile_status='ACTIVE'
    AND (SELECT count(*) FROM unnest(p.skills) saved_skill
      WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(saved_skill)=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill))=1)
 ), saved AS (
  SELECT s.*,r.envelope FROM private.worker_ai_saves s
  JOIN private.worker_ai_reviews r ON r.id=s.review_id AND r.account_id=s.account_id
  WHERE s.account_id=v_owned AND s.receipt->>'profileId'=v_profile_id::text
   AND (EXISTS(
    SELECT 1 FROM private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m WHERE m.worker_account_id=v_owned
     AND m.active AND m.source_review_id=s.review_id AND m.source_request_key=s.client_request_id))
   AND s.receipt->>'accountId'=v_owned::text AND s.receipt->>'reviewId'=r.id::text
   AND s.receipt->'saved'='true'::jsonb AND s.receipt->'authoritative'='true'::jsonb
   AND r.envelope->>'profileId'=v_profile_id::text AND r.envelope->>'accountId'=v_owned::text
   AND r.envelope->>'reviewId'=r.id::text AND r.envelope->'canAccept'='true'::jsonb
   AND r.created_at<=s.created_at AND s.created_at<=r.expires_at
   AND r.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'=encode(extensions.digest(
     ((r.envelope-'displayedContentDigest')||jsonb_build_object('baseHash',r.base_hash))::text,'sha256'),'hex')

 ), bound AS (
  SELECT n.service,m.execution_scope AS mode,m.handoff,c.id AS category_id
  FROM names n JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories c ON c.state='ESTABLISHED'
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm ON cm.category_id=c.id
  JOIN private.taxonomy_confirmed_worker_modes_v1 m ON m.category_id=c.id AND m.execution_scope=cm.execution_scope
   AND m.worker_account_id=v_owned AND m.active
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_capabilities cap ON cap.category_id=c.id AND cap.worker_account_id=v_owned
   AND NOT cap.excluded AND cap.origin='WORKER_CONFIRMED' AND cap.confirmed_at=m.confirmed_at AND cap.updated_at<=m.confirmed_at
  JOIN saved s ON s.review_id=m.source_review_id AND s.client_request_id=m.source_request_key
   AND s.envelope->>'classificationState'='READY'
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_worker_bindings_v1 b ON b.owner_account_id=v_owned
   AND b.profile_id=v_profile_id AND b.source_review_id=s.review_id AND b.request_key=s.client_request_id
   AND b.bound_at=m.confirmed_at AND b.bound_at>=s.created_at
   AND b.result->>'status'='BOUND_WORKER_SERVICES' AND b.result->>'workerProfileId'=v_profile_id::text
  JOIN private.work_taxonomy_review_batches_v1 batch ON batch.owner_account_id=v_owned
   AND batch.source_review_id=s.review_id AND batch.request_key=s.client_request_id AND batch.purpose='WORKER_CAPABILITY'
   AND batch.result->>'status'='COMMITTED' AND batch.result->'requiresBinding'='true'::jsonb
   AND batch.catalog_version=b.catalog_version AND batch.plans=s.envelope->'classificationCandidates'
   AND batch.review_digest=s.envelope->>'displayedContentDigest'
   AND jsonb_typeof(batch.plans)='array' AND jsonb_typeof(batch.result->'items')='array'
   AND b.result->'serviceModeCount'=to_jsonb(jsonb_array_length(batch.plans))
   AND jsonb_array_length(batch.result->'items')=jsonb_array_length(batch.plans)
   AND jsonb_array_length(s.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes')=jsonb_array_length(batch.plans)
  WHERE m.execution_scope IN ('ON_SITE','REMOTE')
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.worker_execution_mode_choices choice
    WHERE choice.worker_profile_id=v_profile_id AND choice.worker_account_id=v_owned
     AND choice.consent_source='EXPLICIT_PROFILE_REVIEW' AND choice.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
     AND m.execution_scope=ANY(choice.modes))
   -- Compare the saved service key, preserving n.service for display. Formatting
   -- changes are not a new skill; arbitrary synonyms still require signed IDs.
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(s.envelope#>'{profile,skills}') skill(value)
     WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(skill.value)=n.service_key)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(s.envelope->'reviewedServiceModes') selected(value)
     WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(selected.value->>'service')=n.service_key
       AND selected.value->>'mode'=m.execution_scope)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch.result->'items') result(value)
     WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(result.value->>'service')=n.service_key
       AND result.value->>'mode'=m.execution_scope AND result.value->>'categoryId'=c.id::text)
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch.plans) plan WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(plan->>'service')=n.service_key
    AND plan->>'mode'=m.execution_scope AND (plan->'handoff') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.handoff)
   AND (m.handoff IS NULL OR (m.execution_scope='REMOTE' AND private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(m.handoff)))
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM names same WHERE same.service_key=n.service_key)=1
   AND (
    -- Preserve exact/registered-alias resolution, including ambiguity refusal.
    ((c.canonical_key=n.service_key OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a
       WHERE a.category_id=c.id AND a.normalized_key=n.service_key))
     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories other WHERE other.state='ESTABLISHED'
      AND (other.canonical_key=n.service_key OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a
       WHERE a.category_id=other.id AND a.normalized_key=n.service_key)))=1)
    OR
    -- A local signed service may name an already-bound ID without a global alias.
    -- This branch only describes existing active authority; it never grants it.
    ((SELECT count(*) FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories other WHERE other.state='ESTABLISHED'
      AND (other.canonical_key=n.service_key OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_aliases a
       WHERE a.category_id=other.id AND a.normalized_key=n.service_key)))=0
     AND s.receipt->>'profileStatus'='ACTIVE'
     AND private.taxonomy_category_path_valid_v1(c.id)
     AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories child
       WHERE child.parent_id=c.id AND child.state='ESTABLISHED')
     AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(batch.plans) WITH ORDINALITY plan(value,ord)
       WHERE plan.value->>'action' IN ('REUSE_EXISTING','EXTEND_MODE')
        AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(plan.value->>'service')=n.service_key AND plan.value->>'mode'=m.execution_scope
        AND (plan.value->'handoff') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM m.handoff
        AND plan.value->>'categoryId'=c.id::text
        AND jsonb_typeof(plan.value->'categoryLabel')='string'
        AND c.label IS NOT DISTINCT FROM plan.value->>'categoryLabel'
        AND plan.value ? 'categoryParentId'
        AND coalesce(to_jsonb(c.parent_id),'null'::jsonb)
            IS NOT DISTINCT FROM plan.value->'categoryParentId'
        AND batch.result->'items'->(plan.ord::integer-1)->>'categoryId'=c.id::text
        AND batch.result->'items'->(plan.ord::integer-1)->>'mode'=m.execution_scope
        AND private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(batch.result->'items'->(plan.ord::integer-1)->>'service')=n.service_key))
   )

 ) SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(DISTINCT (jsonb_build_object('service',service,'mode',mode,
   'categoryId',category_id)||CASE WHEN handoff IS NOT NULL THEN jsonb_build_object('handoff',handoff)
     ELSE '{}'::jsonb END)),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_saved_services FROM bound;


   FOR v_plan IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_review->'classificationCandidates') LOOP
     v_service:=v_plan->>'service';
     IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_review->'reviewedServiceModes') m
       WHERE m->>'service'=v_service AND m->>'mode'=v_plan->>'mode')<>1
       OR v_service=ANY(v_seen) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
     v_seen:=array_append(v_seen,v_service);
     v_one:=private.taxonomy_review_candidate_projection_v2('WORKER_CAPABILITY',jsonb_build_array(v_service),
       jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('service',v_service,'mode',v_plan->>'mode')),v_owned,(p_review->>'conversationId')::uuid);
     IF v_one->>'status'='READY' AND v_one#>'{classificationCandidates,0}'=v_plan THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
     -- No current proposal may be overridden, even when it is invalid or
     -- explicitly clears a previous mode/handoff. Only missing old hints reuse.
     IF v_plan->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REUSE_EXISTING'
       OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(v_hints,'[]'::jsonb)) h
         WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(h->>'service')=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_service))
       OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(v_saved_services) saved
         WHERE saved->>'service'=v_service AND saved->>'mode'=v_plan->>'mode'
           AND saved->>'categoryId'=v_plan->>'categoryId'
           AND saved->'handoff' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_plan->'handoff')
       OR private.worker_remote_review_ready_v1(p_review||jsonb_build_object(
         'profile',jsonb_build_object('skills',jsonb_build_array(v_service)),
         'reviewedServiceModes',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('service',v_service,'mode',v_plan->>'mode')),
         'classificationCandidates',jsonb_build_array(v_plan))) IS NOT TRUE
     THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   END LOOP;
   RETURN cardinality(v_seen)=jsonb_array_length(p_review#>'{profile,skills}');
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_review->'classificationCandidates') p
   WHERE p->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REUSE_EXISTING') THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Only today's complete exact canonical/registered-alias set. User-selected
 -- modes never admit a future category or extend an existing category's scope.
 v_exact:=private.taxonomy_review_exact_projection_v1('WORKER_CAPABILITY',
   p_review#>'{profile,skills}',p_review->'reviewedServiceModes');
 SELECT jsonb_agg(p.value-'handoff' ORDER BY p.ord) INTO v_plans
 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_review->'classificationCandidates') WITH ORDINALITY p(value,ord);
 IF v_exact->>'status'='READY'
   AND p_review->'classificationCatalogVersion'=v_exact->'classificationCatalogVersion'
   AND p_review->'classificationCatalogFingerprint'=v_exact->'classificationCatalogFingerprint'
   AND p_review->'reviewedServiceModes'=v_exact->'reviewedServiceModes'
   AND v_plans=v_exact->'classificationCandidates' THEN RETURN true; END IF;

 -- No additional AI authority: complete current signed READY only.
 -- The caller validates the immutable owner/revision/source/digest/expiry
 -- and this helper rechecks the existing exact leaf ID, REMOTE scope, witness,
 -- consented service set and catalog fingerprint. No new/extended category
 -- or global alias is approved here.
 IF p_review->'classificationCatalogVersion' IS DISTINCT FROM
     (SELECT to_jsonb(catalog_version) FROM private.work_taxonomy_control WHERE singleton)
 OR p_review->>'classificationCatalogFingerprint' IS DISTINCT FROM private.taxonomy_admission_fingerprint_v1()
 OR jsonb_array_length(p_review->'classificationCandidates')
    IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(p_review#>'{profile,skills}')
 OR jsonb_array_length(p_review->'reviewedServiceModes')
    IS DISTINCT FROM jsonb_array_length(p_review#>'{profile,skills}')
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 FOR v_plan IN SELECT value FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_review->'classificationCandidates') LOOP
   IF v_plan->>'action' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REUSE_EXISTING'
     OR v_plan->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'REMOTE'
     OR jsonb_typeof(v_plan->'service') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR length(btrim(v_plan->>'service')) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 120
     OR v_plan->>'categoryId' IS NULL
     OR char_length(v_plan->>'categoryId') IS DISTINCT FROM 36
     OR v_plan->>'categoryId' !~ '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}'
     OR NOT (v_plan ? 'categoryLabel' AND v_plan ? 'categoryParentId')
     OR jsonb_typeof(v_plan->'categoryLabel') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
     OR (v_plan ? 'handoff' AND private.taxonomy_handoff_valid_v1(v_plan->'handoff') IS NOT TRUE)
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   v_service:=private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(v_plan->>'service');
   IF v_service IS NULL OR v_service=ANY(v_seen)
      OR private.taxonomy_risk_triage_v1(v_plan->>'service') IS DISTINCT FROM 'LOW_RISK_CANDIDATE'
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(p_review#>'{profile,skills}') s(value)
     WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(s.value)=v_service;
   IF v_n<>1 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   SELECT count(*) INTO v_n FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_review->'reviewedServiceModes') m(value)
     WHERE private.taxonomy_normalize_v1(m.value->>'service')=v_service AND m.value->>'mode'='REMOTE';
   IF v_n<>1 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   v_category:=(v_plan->>'categoryId')::uuid;
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c
      JOIN private.work_taxonomy_category_modes cm ON cm.category_id=c.id AND cm.execution_scope='REMOTE'
      WHERE c.id=v_category AND c.state='ESTABLISHED'
        AND c.label IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_plan->>'categoryLabel'
        AND coalesce(to_jsonb(c.parent_id),'null'::jsonb) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_plan->'categoryParentId'
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories child
          WHERE child.parent_id=c.id AND child.state='ESTABLISHED')
        AND private.taxonomy_category_path_valid_v1(c.id))
   THEN RETURN false; END IF;
   v_seen:=array_append(v_seen,v_service);
 END LOOP;
 RETURN cardinality(v_seen)=jsonb_array_length(p_review#>'{profile,skills}');
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.worker_saved_areas_v1(aid uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 select coalesce((select r.envelope#>'{profile,workAreas}' from private.worker_ai_saves s
 join private.worker_ai_reviews r on r.id=s.review_id and r.account_id=s.account_id
 where s.account_id=aid order by s.created_at desc,s.review_id desc limit 1),'[]'::jsonb);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.taxonomy_turn_category_identity_v1(p_category uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 WITH RECURSIVE ancestry AS (
  SELECT c.id,c.label,c.parent_id,ARRAY[c.id] path FROM private.work_taxonomy_categories c
   WHERE c.id=p_category AND c.state='ESTABLISHED'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c.id,c.label,c.parent_id,a.path||c.id FROM ancestry a
   JOIN private.work_taxonomy_categories c ON c.id=a.parent_id
   WHERE c.state='ESTABLISHED' AND NOT c.id=ANY(a.path)
 ) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ancestry WHERE parent_id IS NULL)
  THEN encode(extensions.digest(coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_array(id,label,parent_id)
   ORDER BY cardinality(path)),'[]'::jsonb)::text,'sha256'),'hex') END FROM ancestry;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_tags_valid(tags text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select tags is not null and coalesce(array_ndims(tags),1)=1
 and cardinality(tags) between 0 and 3 and array_position(tags,null) is null
 and tags <@ private.review_tag_catalog()
 and cardinality(tags)=(select count(distinct t) from unnest(tags) t); $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.review_tag_catalog()
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ select array['AS_AGREED','CAREFUL','CLEAR_COMMUNICATION','ON_TIME','RELIABLE','RESPECTFUL']::text[]; $function$
